LanguageData.PPTE2_WorkTypeWagesHint: Leave blank to use the default rate. Which work types a prisoner may do is decided by Prison Labor. Piece rate pays per completed output: production per recipe batch, mining per vein, construction per building, growing/cutting per plant, hauling per haul, cleaning per filth, research per tech (split by contribution); other work types (including those added by other MODs) pay per completed job.
LanguageData.PPTE2_IgnoreRiot: Ignore ticket check during mental break / prison break
LanguageData.PPTE2_AllowMealDebt: Allow meal credit (balance may go negative; wages repay the debt first)
LanguageData.PPTE2_AllowPlayerLoans: Allow prisoners to borrow from the player (approve each request)
LanguageData.PPTE2_BadDebtPenalty: Bad debt hurts the lender's mood
LanguageData.PPTE2_LoanTriggerBalance: Loan trigger balance (below this they borrow/beg/rob): {0}
LanguageData.PPTE2_SocialHint: Prisoners start these behaviors on their own when they can't afford food. Robbery is a real melee fight — it can be lethal! Per-prisoner toggles are in the prisoner config window.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomHint: Once a prisoner has saved up enough tickets and served enough time, they may occasionally ask to buy their freedom. You must approve for them to be released automatically — their tickets are used as payment. Per-prisoner overrides are available in the prisoner config window.
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableChildParentPay: Allow child prisoners to use their parents' tickets
LanguageData.PPTE2_ChildPayHint: Child prisoners' meals can be paid from their imprisoned parents' tickets (requires Biotech children). "Own first / Parents first" sets the deduction order; "Shared wallet" treats the family as one account and shows the combined balance. Per-prisoner allow/deny is in the prisoner config window.
LanguageData.PPTE2_GizmoMenuDesc: Manage this prisoner's tickets (give/take), individual settings and ransom.
LanguageData.PPTE2_InvalidNumber: Please enter a positive number (decimals supported).
LanguageData.PPTE2_AllowOrganHarvest: Allow selling organs for this prisoner
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomDisabledGlobal: Ransom is disabled (enable it in MOD settings).
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomRequestPending: {0} offers {1} {2}(s) to buy freedom — awaiting your approval!
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomEligibleWait: Requirements met — waiting for the prisoner to ask…
LanguageData.PPTE2_HediffTip_Debt: Owes {0} {2} of {1}. Wages and other income repay the debt first.
LanguageData.PPTE2_MealOnCredit: {0} ate {1} on credit and now owes {2} {3}(s). Wages and other income will repay the debt first.
LanguageData.PPTE2_LoanRepaidMsg: {0} repaid the loan of {2} {3}(s) borrowed from {1}.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RobberyFailedMsg: {0}'s robbery of {1} failed and {0} got beaten up.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomHasDebt: Cannot ransom with an outstanding loan.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomRequestMsg: {0} offers {1} {2}(s) to buy freedom and awaits your approval.
LanguageData.PPTE2_RansomNoLongerEligible: {0} no longer meets the ransom requirements; request voided.
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableBuiltinLabor: Enable built-in prisoner labour (used when Prison Labor is not installed)
LanguageData.PPTE2_BuiltinLaborDisabledByPL: Prison Labor detected: the built-in labour system is disabled and prisoner work assignment is managed by Prison Labor. Ticket wages are unaffected.
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonerWorkDefaultOn: Force new prisoners to work by default
LanguageData.PPTE2_EnableMotivation: Enable motivation (unsupervised/hungry prisoners lose motivation and slack off)
LanguageData.PPTE2_MotivationThreshold: Laziness threshold (prisoners refuse work below this): {0}
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonWorkHint: Note: warden, doctor, handling, firefighting, hunting and other sensitive/violent work types are never available to prisoners. Work types added by other mods can be enabled here but won't appear as columns in the Prisoners tab (they default to normal priority). Changes apply to all current prisoners immediately.
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonTabDisabledPL: Prison Labor is installed; the built-in labour system is disabled.\nPrisoner work is managed by Prison Labor.
LanguageData.PPTE2_PrisonTabDisabledSetting: The built-in labour system is disabled in the mod settings.
LanguageData.PPTE2_ColWorkToggleTip: Force this prisoner to work for meal tickets (overrides the global default).
LanguageData.PPTE2_ColMotivationTip: Motivation: {0}. Below {1} this prisoner refuses to work.
LanguageData.PPTE2_ColBalanceTip: {0} balance. Click to open this prisoner's menu.
LanguageData.PPTE2_LaborAreaExpandDesc: Designate a prisoner labor area. Colonists will not work inside it, leaving the work to prisoners.
LanguageData.PPTE2_MotivationTip: Motivation falls when unsupervised or starving, and rises when supervised, well-fed or paid. Below {0} the prisoner refuses to work.
